Resolution calling for the disclosure of all details of the agreement made by the Maldivian Government with the Eagle Hills company regarding the "Rasmale" project, and submitted to determine the views of the Members of the People's Majlis on the matter

Preamble

This is a resolution submitted under Article 189 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, calling for the disclosure of all details of the Commercial Terms Agreement concluded between the Government of the Maldives and the UAE's Eagle Hills company to run a project named 'Maldives Waterfront and Marina' in Rasmale, as the Government has not yet disclosed the details of that agreement, and to determine the views of the Members of the People's Majlis on this project.

Resolution

Whereas Article 250(a) of the Constitution of the Republic of Maldives states that any property of the State may be given, sold, leased, disposed of, mortgaged or destroyed, or any agreement relating to any similar matter may be signed, only in accordance with law;

Whereas Article 251(a) of the Constitution of the Republic of Maldives states that no part of the territory of the Maldives shall be given in ownership to any foreign party;

[stamp: Secretariat of the People's Majlis; 3907; 8:05; 12.10.26; D] [signature] 12/10/2026

Whereas Article 29 of the Constitution of the Republic of Maldives grants everyone the freedom to acquire information;

Whereas, in connection with the Commercial Terms Agreement of the 'Maldives Waterfront and Marina' project [?] between the Government and the UAE's Eagle Hills company to run a project in Rasmale, it has been stated that the project [?] [?] [?] has been drawn up, and the Government continues to keep the details of the agreement secret;

Whereas Rasmale is a strong [?] [?] national project linked to the future development of the Maldives;

Whereas, even looking at the details the Government has announced so far regarding this project, the following concerns can be noted:

1. All details of the agreement signed between the Government and the UAE's Eagle Hills company on 21 September 2026 have not been disclosed.

2. The agreement has been drawn up in such a way that, after land is reclaimed with the people's tax money, the cost of reclaiming that land is not returned to the State.

3. A 500-hectare area of land reclaimed in Rasmale has been given to the Eagle Hills company for a period of 99 years.

4. The agreement has been drawn up in such a way that the State receives no equity share [?] or rent.

5. The agreement has been drawn up in such a way that Eagle Hills obtains the right to lease out ([?] [?] [?]) the places developed on that land [?] [?].

6. Keeping the agreement of such a large project secret is something that could cause enormous losses to State property and finances and pave the way for corruption.

[signature]
